points.case_title: Your personal data is used for automated decision-making, profiling or AI training
points.quote_text:
Across Meta Company Products, you can interact with Meta’s generative AI features and experiences, collectively called AI at Meta.

We collect information when you or others use, or exchange information with, AI at Meta, such as:

  • Prompts that can include questions, messages, media and other information you or others share with or send to AI at Meta
  • Responses and other information you receive from AI at Meta. Sometimes these are provided with the help of our AI integrations
  • Actions you ask AI at Meta to take, like customizing the content or ads you see
  • Feedback you give to AI at Meta about its responses
